+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (run settle, session close, stream end), or the test must fail before it waits. A fixture closes also when the test body throws.
+Exception rule: first use an event that already exists (the session closes, the run settles, the feed ends). A hook only in test helpers is permitted. Do not use `.timeLimit`, sleep, poll or retry. Run the full suite one time.
+Work rules: do the work in one agent. Do not run parallel agents on the tree. Edit files only with the edit tool. Do not run swift format.
+
+Group 1: a change can add a race (the audit left these; the failure event can come before the state also in a passing run, so a wait that ends on it fails a good run). Line numbers are from 2026-10-17.
+- [ ] SubmissionBoundaryToolTests.swift:298 `log.changes.wait(untilAtLeast: expected.count, ...)`.
+- [ ] PerCallMountSessionTests.swift:146 `promptsAfterThePumpStops(atLeast:)` (callers 224, 276).
+- [ ] QueuedPassStallWatchTests.swift:150 `holdingLog.wait(until: { $0.contains(where: \.isAnswerEnd) })`.
+- [ ] NoOpToolCallStopTests.swift:81 `events.wait(until: { ... isAnswerEnd })` (runSettled comes first also in a pass).
+- [ ] MountedRunAttachmentCarrierTests.swift:144 the first `next()` loop.
+- [ ] SessionChokepointTests.swift:298 `waitForEvictions` (caller 521).
+- [ ] SessionOutboxToolWiringTests.swift:1546, 1552 the answer-prompt waits.
+- [ ] MountedRunSweptTerminalTests.swift:171 (and 211) the own-terminal wait.
+For each: the decision is "leave, with a comment that names the race", or a named other event.
+
+Group 2: no failure event (a quiet state). Gates of the test hold all other work, or the missing event has nothing after it. The audit left these, and no fix is possible under the rule. Decision: confirm "leave", and say if each place needs a comment in the test.
+- [ ] SubagentQuestionRelayTests root reads for a question or an end that the relay does not send (root run held on its gate).
+- [ ] `outputs(throughNextWorkEnd:)` and `awaitIdle()` where the named failure is "the session stays work".
+- [ ] `isIdleOnceThePumpEnds` / a pump that never ends.
+- [ ] SessionCloseFromOwnWorkTests `closeReturned` (the failure is the hang itself).
+- [ ] Hold gates that wait only for a cancel (`.untilStopped`, `awaitCancelledUnwind`).
+
+Group 3: a full fix needs a production change only for a test hook (not permitted without approval).
+- [ ] `ManualRunClock.waitForSleepers(atLeast:)` in ../FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/RunClock.swift:177 has no cancel handler. Card "T1 follow-up 3/6" uses a test-only extension; its inner task stays suspended until the next clock change. Decision: is that sufficient, or does RunClock get a cancel-aware wait?
+- [ ] `AsyncSemaphore.wait()` (Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Concurrency/AsyncSemaphore.swift:147) does not end on a cancel. Card "T1 follow-up 5/6" uses the existing `waitUnlessCancelled()`. Decision only if that card reports a site that it cannot fix.
+
+Group 4: scope questions from the check of the "never close" group.
+- [ ] Router-only tests (a Router and a resolve, no session): `Router` has no `close()`. Suites: ResolutionProgressPublicSurfaceTests (Tests/FoundationModelsRouterPublicSurfaceTests), EmbedTracingTests, ExtrasPoolResolveTests, OwningProfileTests, ProfileLifecycleTests, ResolveCancellationTests, ResolveTracingTests, ToolSharedProfileTests, and router-only tests in DistinctGenerationSlotsTests, GuidedShapesTests, PromptCacheBudgetTests, ResolveTests and 14 session suites. Decision: out of scope (no close exists), or remove the temp directory on a throw?
+- [ ] Backend-only tests (`container.makeSession` gives a LanguageModelSessionBackend, not a RoutedSession): GenerationQueueTests, TranscriptUpdatesToolLoopTests (runs concurrent tool loops), LanguageModelSessionBackendTests. Decision: in scope or not?
+- [ ] Partial closes: the check counts a test as closed when it closes any session, also when it makes a root and a fork and closes only one, and also when the close is only in a `catch`. Decision: audit those too (one more card), or not.
+
+- [ ] Write the decision for each item as a comment on this card. For each "change" decision, add a card with tag `t1-followup`. #t1-followup
\ No newline at end of file
